echo.ui.use_help: Consumed only after a successful effect.
echo.ui.equip_help: Close this panel, select hotbar 1, then right-click the target.
echo.ui.second_point: First point selected. Right-click point two; ESC cancels.
echo.signal.marked: You have been marked for hunting!
echo.error.wrong_faction: Your faction cannot use this card. Trading and dropping are allowed.
echo.error.passive: Passive cards work while carried and cannot be activated.
echo.error.effect_active: An equal or stronger effect is active, or the target state is unsuitable. Card retained.
echo.error.effect_unavailable: This effect is not connected yet. Card retained.
item.noellesroles.echo_card_proxy.desc: Equip a card in Freight Inventory, then right-click its target with this tool. The proxy is not a resource.
echo.ui.locked: Bound or locked: cannot move, drop or craft
echo.ui.select_two: Select two base cards to preview crafting. Select one and click an empty slot to move.
echo.ui.server_authority: Resources are confirmed by the server
echo.ui.pack_help: Up to two packs of the same quality per slot. Opening requires an extra empty slot and a 1.5s channel; closing cancels it. Choose one of three cards within 20s, or the first is chosen automatically.
echo.ui.passive: Passive: active while held; highest tier only
echo.error.full: Inventory full. Opening requires an extra empty slot.
echo.error.key_limit: KEY capacity or draft reservation limit reached.
echo.error.locked: This resource is bound or locked in a trade.
echo.error.no_resource: This resource is no longer in your inventory.
echo.error.invalid_recipe: Requires two distinct usable base-card instances in the same recipe group.
echo.error.invalid_offer: Draft already resolved, expired or invalid choice.
echo.error.busy: Finish the current pack, choice or trade first.
echo.error.downed: Unavailable while downed, controlled or departed.
echo.card.silent_collector.name: Silent Collector
echo.card.silent_collector.desc: Within 60s, silence the next successful collection or delivery. Does not hide cargo pulses, charging or public progress.
echo.card.decoy_dummy.name: Decoy Dummy
echo.card.decoy_dummy.desc: Place a 15s decoy on visible ground within 6 blocks. Every 3s it emits collection sounds audible within 24 blocks. Cannot block attacks or capture objectives.
echo.card.short_dash.name: Short Dash
echo.card.short_dash.desc: Move 25%% faster for 3s. Cargo penalties remain; does not remove control.
echo.card.cargo_lining.name: Cargo Lining
echo.card.cargo_lining.desc: Passive: cargo capacity 3 and cargo slowdown 5%%. Highest logistics tier only; excess cargo drops when removed.
echo.card.stabilizer.name: Stabilizer
echo.card.stabilizer.desc: Give an operations beacon within 3 blocks one rollback shield. Does not block pollution lockout; fails if active or already shielded.
echo.card.purifier.name: Purifier
echo.card.purifier.desc: Remove pollution lockout from a beacon within 3 blocks. Does not restore progress, clear pollution cooldown or remove pulse pauses.
echo.card.team_radar.name: Team Radar
echo.card.team_radar.desc: Scan real Interceptors within 20 blocks. Only you see their outlines for 3s. No targets means no consumption.
echo.card.sound_key.name: Sound Key
echo.card.sound_key.desc: During operations, use a core controller within 3 blocks to open all core entrances for 15s. All factions may use it; one KEY per player.
echo.card.door_wedge.name: Door Wedge
echo.card.door_wedge.desc: Extend an open core gate within 3 blocks by 5s, capped at 25s from now. Cannot affect the central evacuation gate.
echo.card.crystal_sniff.name: Crystal Sniff
echo.card.crystal_sniff.desc: For 5s, update the nearest ordinary cargo carrier's eight-way direction every second, privately. Reveals no name or coordinates.
echo.card.pollution_accelerator.name: Pollution Accelerator
echo.card.pollution_accelerator.desc: Within 60s, channel your next successful pollution in 2s. Cancelling preserves the charge; shared beacon cooldown is unchanged.
echo.card.overload_pulse.name: Overload Pulse
echo.card.overload_pulse.desc: Pause a charging operations beacon within 8 blocks for 5s. Cannot close evacuation gates; fails if already paused or active.
echo.card.false_echo.name: False Echo
echo.card.false_echo.desc: Fake one map-wide delivery sound and a 3s glow on visible ground within 12 blocks. No real progress; shared false-delivery cooldown 15s.
echo.card.hunt_mark.name: Hunt Mark
echo.card.hunt_mark.desc: Mark a visible standing non-Interceptor within 12 blocks for 12s. Privately reveal them for 1s every 4s. Reveal yourself to the target for 1s.
echo.card.key_disruptor.name: Key Disruptor
echo.card.key_disruptor.desc: Force a visible standing non-Interceptor within 10 blocks to drop their KEY. Cancels related offers; never destroys or copies the key.
echo.card.trade_offer.name: Trade Offer
echo.card.trade_offer.desc: Within 60s, your next trade proposal reaches 10 blocks and lasts 60s. Rejection does not refund the charge.
echo.card.faction_mask.name: Faction Mask
echo.card.faction_mask.desc: For 30s, normal clients display you in the observer's friendly color. Real faction is unchanged. Attacking or a valid hit removes it.
echo.card.afterimage.name: Afterimage
echo.card.afterimage.desc: Leave a 4s image and gain 20%% movement speed for 3s. Grants no invulnerability and does not hide cargo pulses.
echo.card.black_sniff.name: Black Sniff
echo.card.black_sniff.desc: For 8s, show the direction of the nearest eligible black crystal or ground black-market pack within 48 blocks. Non-smugglers only detect packs.
echo.card.forged_signal.name: Forged Signal
echo.card.forged_signal.desc: Fake a 3s pollution glow or one delivery sound on visible ground within 12 blocks. No real state change; forgery cooldown 15s.
echo.card.pack_hook.name: Pack Hook
echo.card.pack_hook.desc: Randomly transfer one unbound, unlocked pack from a visible standing player within 5 blocks. Per-target cooldown 30s. No space means no consumption.
echo.card.silent_rig.name: Silent Rig
echo.card.silent_rig.desc: Within 60s, silence two successful collections or deliveries. Cargo pulses and public progress remain visible.
echo.card.silent_dummy.name: Silent Dummy
echo.card.silent_dummy.desc: Place a silent 20s decoy within 6 blocks. For its first 5s, misdirect Interceptor sniffing within 20 blocks. Does not alter real cargo records.
echo.card.long_dash.name: Long Dash
echo.card.long_dash.desc: Move 35%% faster for 5s. Does not stack with lower mobility or remove control.
echo.card.cargo_harness.name: Cargo Harness
echo.card.cargo_harness.desc: Passive: cargo capacity 4 with no cargo slowdown. Cargo pulses remain. Highest logistics tier only.
echo.card.purge_stabilizer.name: Purge Stabilizer
echo.card.purge_stabilizer.desc: Unlock an inactive operations beacon within 3 blocks, then add one rollback shield. Does not clear pulse pauses or pollution cooldown.
echo.card.team_scan.name: Team Scan
echo.card.team_scan.desc: Scan real Interceptors within 28 blocks. Only you see their outlines for 5s. No targets means no consumption.
echo.card.master_key.name: Master Key
echo.card.master_key.desc: Open core entrances within 3 blocks for 20s and privately outline real Interceptors within 12 blocks inside for 2s. All factions; one KEY per player.
echo.card.global_pulse.name: Global Pulse
echo.card.global_pulse.desc: For 8s, privately update directions to up to three nearest ordinary cargo carriers every second. Silent dummies can mislead the first 5s.
echo.card.strong_pollution.name: Strong Pollution
echo.card.strong_pollution.desc: Within 60s, your next successful pollution channels in 2s and rolls back 40 percentage points. Stabilizers block rollback; lockout and cooldown stay unchanged.
echo.card.false_dispatch.name: Double False Echo
echo.card.false_dispatch.desc: Pick two visible ground points within 12 blocks, at least 6 blocks apart. Fake a delivery at each, 2s apart. Shared false-delivery cooldown 15s.
echo.card.hunt_pressure.name: Hunt Pressure
echo.card.hunt_pressure.desc: Slow a standing non-Interceptor within 12 blocks by 10%% for 8s. Both Interceptors see them for 4s; the target sees you for 2s. No extra damage.
echo.card.trade_pact.name: Trade Pact
echo.card.trade_pact.desc: Within 60s, two trade proposals reach 16 blocks and each last 60s. Real confirmation and final inventory capacity checks still apply.
echo.card.double_mask.name: Double Mask
echo.card.double_mask.desc: Friendly-color disguise for 45s and suppress one of your KEY direction pulses. Attacking or a valid hit removes it. Contract glints are not suppressed.
echo.card.residual_veil.name: Residual Veil
echo.card.residual_veil.desc: Leave a 6s image and gain 25%% movement speed for 4s. No invulnerability, real invisibility or pulse suppression.
echo.card.salvage_magnet.name: Salvage Magnet
echo.card.salvage_magnet.desc: Show eligible black-crystal or black-market-pack direction within 48 blocks for 20s. Also collect the nearest visible ground pack within 4 blocks if it fits; never destroys it.
echo.signal.key_disrupted: Your KEY was knocked to the ground by a disruptor.
echo.ui.forgery_choice: Use: fake pollution; sneak-use: fake delivery sound
echo.card.forged_dispatch.name: Forged Dispatch
echo.card.forged_dispatch.desc: Fake one delivery sound and a 5s pollution glow on visible ground within 12 blocks. Shared forgery cooldown 15s. Never changes real progress.
echo.trade.title: Trade
echo.trade.invited: %s proposed a trade. Open the Echo backpack trade panel to accept or reject.
echo.trade.target_help: Choose a nearby player. Base range 3 blocks with line of sight; trade cards extend it to 10/16. Sending a proposal starts a 15s cooldown.
echo.trade.confirm_help: Both players must confirm the same version. Any offer or inventory change clears both confirmations. Gifts allowed; both-empty offers rejected.
echo.trade.privacy: Only offers are shared, not full bags or factions. Closing never confirms.
echo.contract.title: Private Contract
echo.contract.succeeded: Your personal success is locked. The main match continues.
echo.contract.smuggler.name: Smuggler
echo.contract.smuggler.desc: Collect black crystals with a 4s channel, deliver each at your assigned dropoff in 2s. Two deliveries lock success. Shared cargo capacity, at most two black crystals. Only the owner can retrieve drops; they return after 30s. Nodes recover in 60s.
echo.contract.information_dealer.name: Information Dealer
echo.contract.information_dealer.desc: Complete one real bidirectional trade with a true carrier and one with a true interceptor. Gifts, empty offers, brokers and returning the same instances do not count. Both faction credits lock success.
echo.contract.scavenger.name: Scavenger
echo.contract.scavenger.desc: Resolve three distinct packs, then survive a normal match ending online and HEALTHY or WOUNDED. Downed or departed fails. Interceptors within 32 blocks see a 2s glint every 15s. No early retirement.
echo.contract.key_dealer.name: KEY Dealer
echo.contract.key_dealer.desc: Trade a KEY to a carrier who then consumes that exact instance at a core controller. Only your latest valid chain counts. Transfer, dropping, crafting or theft invalidates it. Use emits a 2s enhanced pulse to interceptors within 48 blocks.
echo.contract.retire_help: After an instant contract succeeds, stand still at the broker exit for 3s, then confirm. Staying is allowed. Retirement never adds to the carrier escape quota.
echo.contract.retire_warning: Irreversible: drop all mode resources, become a spectator and leave living voice chat. Locked personal success is retained.
echo.contract.state.armed: Three packs; survive until the end
echo.connection.restored: Match state restored. Your reconnect grace is used; another disconnect permanently leaves this match.
echo.map.editing: Editing %s (%s). Unsaved memory draft expires on disconnect, map change, match start or 30 idle minutes.
echo.map.cancelled: Memory draft discarded. No file or building was changed.
echo.map.changed: Recorded %s / %s, draft revision %s; not saved yet.
echo.map.corner: Corner %s: %s. The volume includes both selected blocks.
echo.map.summary: %s · draft revision %s · spawns: carrier %s / interceptor %s / broker %s
echo.map.confirm: Overwrite requested. Click to fill the confirmation command within 30 seconds: %s. Draft/file changes invalidate it.
echo.map.saved: Atomically saved template coordinates for %s. Active matches are unchanged; loaded again next match.
echo.map.reload: Mode configuration is read for each match. Active matches retain frozen configuration; edits apply next match.
echo.map.preview: Private preview: %s entries for 30 seconds. Up to 256 nearest boxes within 128 blocks and 32 labels within 48; no world edits.
echo.map.routes_started: Bounded walking scan started: closed-core open area, each virtually opened entrance and return paths. No chunks loaded or blocks changed.
echo.map.routes_cancelled: Route scan cancelled or invalidated by map, match or permission changes.
echo.map.routes_passed: Automatic walking sample passed (%s ground nodes). Diagnostic only; door throughput, sightlines and human routes still need playtesting.
echo.map.routes_failed: Unreachable target or closed-core bypass (%s sampled nodes). Stages and targets follow.
echo.map.routes_manual: Route scan incomplete (%s nodes): budget, chunks or special terrain require manual map-maker acceptance. This is not a pass.
echo.map.admission_started: Map reset complete. Checking this start's routes incrementally before assigning roles.
echo.map.admission_failed: Route admission failed: %s. Start cancelled; fix the problem and start again.
echo.map.admission_required: No valid single-use route permit. Start cancelled; inspect route errors and start again.
echo.map.admission_passed: This start's route sample passed (%s nodes). Continuing initialization.
echo.map.admission_manual: Not all routes could be proven. Waiting for map-maker acceptance; known failures cannot be overridden. Confirmation expires in 30 seconds.
echo.map.admission_token: Only after personally verifying ALL required routes, run: %s. Single-use; bound to this map, configuration and terrain. Changes invalidate it.
echo.map.admission_confirmed: Administrator acceptance of this start's unproven routes recorded. Continuing initialization; this is not full gameplay acceptance.
echo.card.silent_collector.mechanic: Marks successful ordinary collection or submission as silent. Cancellation does not spend a charge; ongoing cargo echoes and public progress remain.
echo.card.silent_rig.mechanic: Grants multiple silent collection/submission charges. Only successful actions spend charges; ongoing echoes and public progress remain.
echo.card.decoy_dummy.mechanic: Places a dummy on visible ground that periodically makes collection sounds. No collision, resources or objective presence; wolves can dismantle it nearby.
echo.card.silent_dummy.mechanic: Places a silent dummy that temporarily attracts nearby wolves' tracking directions. Real ownership and contracts never change.
echo.card.short_dash.mechanic: Temporarily boosts movement. Does not remove control or stack with higher mobility; cargo slowdown still applies.
echo.card.long_dash.mechanic: Higher-rank mobility replaces weaker boosts. Does not remove control; cargo slowdown still applies.
echo.card.cargo_lining.mechanic: Passive while stored: increases cargo capacity and reduces cargo slowdown. Removing it drops excess cargo; echoes remain.
echo.card.cargo_harness.mechanic: Advanced passive logistics. A better configured baseline takes precedence; removing it drops excess cargo.
echo.card.stabilizer.mechanic: Adds a single-use rollback shield to an inactive operations beacon. Does not prevent pollution lock; an existing shield rejects use.
echo.card.purifier.mechanic: Clears an operations beacon's pollution lock. Does not restore progress or clear pollution cooldown and pulse pause.
echo.card.purge_stabilizer.mechanic: Clears pollution lock and adds a rollback shield to an inactive beacon. No consumption if neither effect can change.
echo.card.team_radar.mechanic: Privately outlines true interceptors within range at activation. New arrivals are not added to the authorized set.
echo.card.team_scan.mechanic: Advanced true-interceptor scan. Only you see the frozen target set; disguise cannot fool it.
echo.card.sound_key.mechanic: A KEY that opens all core gates during operations. Consumed only on successful opening; all factions can use it. KEY pulses remain.
echo.card.master_key.mechanic: A KEY that opens the core and privately scans true interceptors inside. An empty scan does not prevent opening.
echo.card.door_wedge.mechanic: Extends an already-open core gate up to the remaining-duration cap. Cannot affect the evacuation gate.
echo.card.crystal_sniff.mechanic: Tracks the nearest standing ordinary-cargo carrier by sector, without names or coordinates. A silent dummy may mislead it.
echo.card.global_pulse.mechanic: Tracks the nearest ordinary carriers selected at activation by direction only. Dummy deception applies; dropping cargo or leaving revokes tracking.
echo.card.pollution_accelerator.mechanic: Marks future pollution as faster. Only successful pollution spends a charge; the beacon's shared cooldown is unchanged.
echo.card.strong_pollution.mechanic: Marks pollution with configured faster channel and rollback. A stability shield blocks rollback; lock and cooldown remain unchanged.
echo.card.overload_pulse.mechanic: Pauses a charging operations beacon. Already paused or active beacons reject use; evacuation gates are unaffected.
echo.card.false_echo.mechanic: Fakes a submission sound and highlight on visible ground. No progress, rewards or contracts; shares the false-submission cooldown.
echo.card.false_dispatch.mechanic: Validates two visible ground points together and delays the second fake submission. Points never follow players; shares false-submission cooldown.
echo.card.hunt_mark.mechanic: Marks a visible standing non-wolf, periodically showing you an outline and briefly exposing you to the target. No damage bonus.
echo.card.hunt_pressure.mechanic: Slows a visible standing non-wolf and outlines them to at most two wolves. Briefly exposes the caster; protection is unchanged.
echo.card.key_disruptor.mechanic: Forces a visible standing non-wolf to drop their actual KEY, cancelling their trade first. Never copies or destroys the KEY.
echo.card.trade_offer.mechanic: Grants enhanced proposals. Creating a proposal spends a charge; rejection or cancellation does not refund it. Base trading remains free.
echo.card.trade_pact.mechanic: Grants multiple enhanced proposals. Each freezes its range and deadline when created; sight, quotes and capacity are still validated.
echo.card.faction_mask.mechanic: Appears friendly to observers without changing true faction, permissions or scans. Attacking or taking an effective hit breaks it.
echo.card.double_mask.mechanic: Friendly-color disguise suppressing a limited number of ordinary KEY pulses, not contract pulses. Attacking or effective damage breaks it.
echo.card.afterimage.mechanic: Leaves a non-colliding image and grants a temporary speed boost. No invulnerability or suppression of cargo and KEY echoes.
echo.card.residual_veil.mechanic: Advanced image and mobility. No invulnerability, invisibility, attack cooldown reset or echo suppression.
echo.card.black_sniff.mechanic: Points to the nearest black crystal you may collect or ground black-market pack. Non-smugglers only find packs; inventories remain private.
echo.card.salvage_magnet.mechanic: Points to eligible black cargo or a ground black-market pack, and attempts to collect a nearby visible ground pack. A full bag never destroys it.
echo.card.forged_signal.mechanic: Places fake pollution on visible ground; hold sneak for a fake submission instead. Presentation only; shares forgery cooldown.
echo.card.forged_dispatch.mechanic: Fakes submission sound and pollution light together on visible ground. Shared forgery cooldown; no real objective changes.
echo.card.pack_hook.mechanic: Randomly transfers one unlocked, unbound pack from a visible standing target after checking your capacity. Per-target cooldown applies.
echo.spec.title: Specialization
echo.spec.reveal_hint: Pick your faction specialization; move to skip
echo.spec.porter.name: Porter
echo.spec.porter.desc: Steady logistics: cargo capacity +1 (max 4), cargo slowdown reduced by 3 points.
echo.spec.scout.name: Scout
echo.spec.scout.desc: Fast sampling: collection channel 80%, cargo capacity -1 (min 1).
echo.spec.hunter.name: Hunter
echo.spec.hunter.desc: Direct pressure: cutter charge 85%, cooldown 90%; pollution unchanged.
echo.spec.saboteur.name: Saboteur
echo.spec.saboteur.desc: Delay the rhythm: pollution channel 75%; cutter cooldown 120%.
echo.spec.smuggler.name: Smuggler
echo.spec.smuggler.desc: Black cargo route: black crystal collection 80%; trade range unchanged.
echo.spec.fixer.name: Fixer
echo.spec.fixer.desc: Trade route: base trade range +2 blocks, proposal cooldown 60%; black collection unchanged.

echo.editor.hud.gate_off: This map: not enabled as an Echo Freight map

echo.intro.cue.map.title: Echo Freight
echo.intro.cue.map.body: Move cargo to the beacons and keep the interceptors off your route.
echo.intro.cue.interceptor.title: Interceptors
echo.intro.cue.interceptor.body: The first strike downs; a strike after rescue eliminates. Hold the core gate and stop the evacuation.
echo.intro.cue.carrier.title: Carriers
echo.intro.cue.carrier.body: Carry at most three cargo items; cargo slows you down. An ally can rescue you once after you go down.
echo.intro.cue.facility.title: Facilities
echo.intro.cue.facility.body: The core gate needs the key and beacon progress; gate overload works once.
echo.intro.cue.evacuation.title: Evacuation
echo.intro.cue.evacuation.body: Once the evacuation window opens, stand in the zone to leave.
echo.intro.cue.specialization.title: Specialization
echo.intro.cue.specialization.body: Pick a specialization during the safe phase; it locks when operations begin.
echo.skill.steady_haul.name: Steady Haul
echo.skill.steady_haul.desc: +1 carry capacity and no cargo slowdown for 8s.
echo.skill.swift_pick.name: Swift Pick
echo.skill.swift_pick.desc: Your next crate or crystal pickup is instant within 10s.
echo.skill.lock_on.name: Lock On
echo.skill.lock_on.desc: Your next cutter swing needs no charge within 10s.
echo.skill.surge.name: Surge
echo.skill.surge.desc: Your next pollution counts as strong pollution and lasts 40 ticks within 10s.
echo.skill.dark_cache.name: Dark Cache
echo.skill.dark_cache.desc: Your next black-market drop-off is instant and cargo no longer slows you for 12s.
echo.skill.broker_deal.name: Broker Deal
echo.skill.broker_deal.desc: Immediately open a trade proposal with a target within trade range +4 blocks.

echo.editor.title: Echo Freight Map Editor
echo.editor.hint.map_id: Map id (blank auto-names it, e.g. echo_map)
echo.editor.hint.nonce: Overwrite confirm token (the string from the save hint)
echo.editor.label.remove: Remove point (select a field, then enter an id)
echo.editor.note.config1: New starts from a blank config; Load reads the saved map config file (echo_freight/maps/<mapId>.json).
echo.editor.note.config2: Self-contained: you can create, mark and save without loading an Areas map - coordinates are recorded as-is. If a battle map IS loaded, they are stored via that map's template/paste offset (recommended).
echo.editor.note.config3: All changes stay in memory until saved; they apply when the map is loaded next round.
echo.editor.note.config4: Enable as Echo Map = mark the current Areas map as an Echo Freight map so Echo map configs can be loaded on it (requires a loaded Areas map).
echo.editor.note.no_session: Create or load a map config on the Map Config tab first; existing points are listed here.
echo.editor.note.empty_kind: No points of this kind yet: fill in the id and player tier above, then press Mark.
echo.editor.note.singleton: This kind has exactly one entry map-wide: re-mark to overwrite it; nothing to delete.
echo.editor.note.volume: Corners come from the crosshair or manual input (integer block coords); gate volumes are <=1024 blocks and must not overlap.
echo.editor.tip.point: Block kinds: aim at a block and press Mark. Spawn kinds: stand at the spot and press Mark. Players = activation tier: the point only spawns in rounds with at least this many players (default 6; beacons/crystals/crates only).
echo.editor.tip.volume: Set corners A/B first (from crosshair or manual input), pick a volume kind, then Write Volume; gates must be ordinary solid blocks.
echo.editor.tip.save: Saving automatically checks every roster tier (6-12 players) and refuses to write with issues; preview only renders boxes client-side.
echo.hunter.rend.name: Rend
echo.hunter.rend.desc: Three-hit melee combo. The third hit is a bleeding finisher, and chaining only allows a 0.9 s window between hits; a whiff or a timeout breaks the chain.
echo.hunter.rend.passive.name: Blood Scent
echo.hunter.rend.passive.desc: While a bleeding prey is within 24 blocks, focus builds 50% faster.
echo.hunter.rend.attack.name: Triple Claw
echo.hunter.rend.attack.desc: Hit 1 reaches 2 blocks; hit 2 extends slightly and adds 1 bleed stack; hit 3 lunges 1 block further and applies all 3 stacks at once (+2 s downed per stack). The finisher has a longer recovery.
echo.hunter.weaver.name: Weaver
echo.hunter.weaver.desc: Ranged web bolt. A long-range hit downs the prey and leaves webbing behind; at point-blank range it becomes a 120-degree sweep.
echo.hunter.weaver.passive.name: Thread Sense
echo.hunter.weaver.passive.desc: Prey that stays still for over 3 seconds within 20 blocks builds your focus 50% faster; hitting prey standing in webbing extends the downed time by 2 more seconds.
echo.hunter.weaver.attack.name: Web Bolt
echo.hunter.weaver.attack.desc: Flies on an arc, affected by gravity, lives at most 2 seconds. Even a miss leaves webbing at the impact point (radius 2.2, 5 s, -45% movement speed).
echo.hunter.locked: You cannot change class now: only during the preparation phase, and only with the Hunter specialization.
echo.hunter.none: You are not an interceptor, or your specialization is not Hunter.
echo.skill.rend_dash.name: Tearing Lunge
echo.skill.rend_dash.desc: Lunge 4 blocks along your line of sight and push the three-hit combo straight to the finisher; wasted if you do not swing within 1 second.
echo.skill.web_nest.name: Web Nest
echo.skill.web_nest.desc: Spin a 4.5-block webbing field under your feet for 12 seconds: prey inside move 55% slower, and your focus no longer decays.
